title: Northstar — three themed design systems (Studio / Fieldwork / Nocturne)
description: Self-contained multi-theme design system: one component vocabulary (buttons, badges, chips, cards, fields, tabs, switch, dialog, toast, avatar, table, sidebar app shell, landing + gallery recipes) driven entirely by CSS custom properties. Three complete themes on one var contract: Studio (quiet product clarity, indigo #5a46c5, Inter 600 -0.055em, radii 8/14/22), Fieldwork (bold editorial, rust #b73e15 on parchment #f2efe8, Arial Narrow 800 uppercase, tight radii 4/6/8), Nocturne (dark developer tool, mint #b3e9dd on #12151a, Inter 500 -0.06em). Zero dependencies, fully scoped to .ds-kit, a11y-first (skip links, focus-visible, ARIA tabs/dialog/switch, aria-live toasts, keyboard tab nav), prefers-reduced-motion + in-app motion pause.
origin: user-supplied single-file interactive preview (northstar-preview.html, 73KB, 2026-10-23). Self-described original work informed by Storm Lab (editorial energy), Untitled UI + shadcn (product structure), Motion (interaction patterns). No third-party assets bundled.

approval.note: user provided the file and asked to add it to the library; analyzed and filed without modification of any design value

license: original work (user-supplied) — treat as user-approved base layer

architecture.tokens.css: all design tokens + components + page recipes, scoped to .ds-kit (themes via [data-theme] blocks)
architecture.themes.json: machine-readable theme definitions (colors, radius, fonts, display weight/tracking/transform) — the build-pipeline source of truth
architecture.themes.js: themes.json exposed as window.NORTHSTAR_THEMES for the runtime
architecture.app.js: dependency-free interactive reference app (landing / workspace / components views, state, event delegation)
architecture.preview.html: loads tokens.css + themes.js + app.js — renders the full interactive preview

usage.as_design_system: import tokens.css; wrap your app in .ds-kit with data-theme=studio|field|nocturne; use the ds-* classes
usage.theming: swap any --ds-* variable per theme block or override at runtime; themes.json is the source for generating new themes
usage.interaction_reference: open preview.html for working examples of every component state, dialog, toast, and the motion-pause pattern
usage.motion: built-in: ds-enter 420ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 50ms stagger, 12px travel; [data-motion=reduced] kills all animation
